description:
Mirror of selected Irish national open geodata, served as GeoParquet with STAC metadata. The first wave carries the Tailte Éireann National Statutory Boundaries generalised to 20 m (counties, provinces, administrative areas, municipal districts, local electoral areas, electoral divisions, baronies, civil parishes, townlands), the 2017 Dáil constituencies and the 2015 Gaeltacht boundaries, the 2022 CSO statistical boundaries used to publish Census of Population results (Small Areas, Electoral Divisions, Local Electoral Areas, Urban Areas), three point layers of the National Placenames Gazetteer, the four NPWS designated-area layers (Special Areas of Conservation, Special Protection Areas, Natural Heritage Areas and proposed Natural Heritage Areas), the EPA Water Framework Directive Cycle 3 waterbodies (river, lake, coastal, ground) and designated bathing waters, EPA licensed industrial facilities, the Radon Risk Map of Ireland and the air-quality monitoring sites and zones, and the roads, rail network and railway stations of the National 250k Map of Ireland. Every collection names the publisher's dataset page as its provenance and attaches the live service it was read from. Publisher titles, descriptions and keywords are taken over unchanged. Data sourced 2026-09-20; licence CC BY 4.0.

**Disclaimer:** a demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for disseminating open geodatasets. This catalog republishes data from its original publishers in cloud-native formats such as GeoParquet and PMTiles, with STAC metadata — open, standards-based and freely accessible to everyone. It is not an official service of the original publishers, which remain the authoritative source.
